# Furniture Blueprints

> Furniture Blueprints is a parametric furniture design tool. Enter dimensions to instantly generate a 3D preview, engineering drawings (three views + per-part drawings), joinery detail drawings, a cut list, and printable plans. Supports mm/inch units. Free tier includes the square stool, pencil holder and workbench; paid plans unlock all templates.

## Product

- [Home](/en): overview, templates, plans.
- [Start designing](/en/app): the furniture catalog.
- [Templates](/en/templates): every furniture template with dimensions and joinery notes.
- [Free workbench plans](/en/workbench)
- [Pricing](/en/pricing): Pro monthly / annual, lifetime, and single-template purchases (USD).
- [Help](/en/help)

## Key features

- Parametric design: pick a template → enter dimensions → live 3D preview, no CAD skills needed.
- Engineering drawings: three views, per-part drawings, mortise & tenon details.
- Cut list and materials list in mm or inches / board feet.
- 1:1 full-size templates for joinery layout.
